examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?

examples.text: Да. Спускайтесь вниз, она там стоит.
examples.trans: Yes. Go downstairs, it's parked there.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

examples.text: От такой суеты на кухне у кого угодно поедет крыша!
examples.trans: From such commotion in the kitchen anyone would lose their mind!

examples.text: Летом на высокой крыше соседнего здания открывают уютное кафе.
examples.trans: In summer they open a cozy cafe on the high roof of the neighboring building.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

наделать.gloss: to do (something bad); to make a lot of

meanings.en: to do, to get up to (something bad)
meanings.note: что ты наделал? = what have you done?

examples.trans: Oh no, what have I done!
He made a lot of mistakes.

related.gloss: to get up to, to do (something bad)

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: + accusative; за + accusative for the reason.

examples.trans: What are you punishing me for?

examples.text: Ладно, сильно не наказывай, они просто ошиблись.
examples.trans: All right, don't punish them too hard, they just made a mistake.

examples.text: Шеф, что за странные намёки? Ничего не было!
examples.trans: Chef, what's with the weird insinuations? Nothing happened!

examples.text: Виктор, ты этот тонкий намёк понял?
examples.trans: Viktor, did you get that subtle hint?

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: The director announced the start of the meeting.

examples.text: Перед тем, как я объявлю победителя, внимание!
examples.trans: Before I announce the winner, your attention!

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: Used as an exclamation of approval.

examples.text: Отлично, Ваня! Вот это твой образ!
examples.trans: Perfect, Vanya! That right there is your look!

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.en: a bit earlier, a little earlier

examples.trans: I decided to return home a bit earlier.
Let's wake up a bit earlier tomorrow.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.en: search (for a missing or wanted person)
meanings.note: объявить в розыск = to put on the wanted list

examples.trans: Then they'll put me on the wanted list.
The police put out a search for him.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

сбрасывать.gloss: to throw down, drop; to reject (a call)

meanings.en: to reject a call, hang up

examples.trans: Yet she hangs up on me for the second time.
Why do you keep hanging up on my calls?

examples.text: Виктор Степанович, сегодня никак не могу.
examples.trans: Viktor Stepanovich, I really can't today.

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: That's not what I mean at all.

examples.text: Нет, Вика, я совсем не это хочу сказать.
examples.trans: No, Vika, that's not what I mean at all.

спускать.gloss: to lower, let down; (глаз не спускать) to keep one's eyes on

examples.trans: Don't take your eyes off her.

meanings.note: спустить ногу на пол = to put a foot down on the floor

examples.text: Пусть он одну ногу спустит на пол.
examples.trans: Have him put one foot down on the floor.
The sailors lowered the boat into the water.
You can see it at once.
Now there's a businesswoman, you can see it at once.

examples.text: Теперь я начальник нашей стройки. Ты уволен!
examples.trans: Now I'm the boss of our building site. You're fired!

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: to leave on foot, go away

examples.trans: The cup fell off the table.

examples.text: А потом на меня упал мусор с ветки.
examples.trans: And then rubbish fell on me from a branch.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
